sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Mind Games Remixes LP Part 1 supplied differentiated August 2026 exact-track descriptions for broken-beat, crawling, displaced-stab and narrative-remix structures. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/628994-Juno_Recommends_Breakbeat/33361848-Chart

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: DMX Krew and Ben Pest supplied exact electro propositions whose restless cover logic and mechanical breakdowns cross the volume's selection lens without requiring one production world. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/629638-Juno_Recommends_Electro/33361863-Chart

OVERLOOKED / CATALOGUE WINDOW: Galaxy 2 Galaxy's reissue and BIZ's current limited-series circulation reopened Detroit/jazz and metallic-percussive catalogue questions without prestige credit. https://www.juno.co.uk/charts/juno-recommends/629051-Juno_Recommends_Techno/33361884-Chart
exclusions: Run 208's entire source field, recent Runs 202–208 fields, every prior ranked lead and alternate, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition check avoided every selected boundary from completed exploration Runs 202, 203, 206, 207 and 208. Current placements are candidate-specific questions, not a boundary-distribution quota.
Nine leads survived because each has exact-track or exact-version evidence and a concrete transition/local-run/long-form question; no list slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. Stardancer → Migration is not protected by implication. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
